units.source_text: 大辅命妇是个乖巧的人，她觉得这琴弹得并不特别好，不便教公子多听，便说道：“月亮暗起来了。

en.t: Dainagon no Myobu was a tactful woman. Thinking that the koto playing was not especially good and that it would be awkward to let the prince hear too much of it, she said, "The moon has grown dim.

units.source_text: 我想起今晚有客人来，我不在屋里，怕会见怪。

en.t: I have just remembered that guests are coming tonight. If I am not in my room, people may think it strange.

units.source_text: 以后再从容地听吧。

en.t: Please listen at leisure another time.

units.source_text: 我把格子窗关上了，好么？”

en.t: Shall I close the lattice shutters now?"

units.source_text: 她并不劝她再弹，便回自己房里去了。

en.t: Without urging her to play again, she returned to her own room.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说：“我正想听下去，怎么不弹了？

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "I was just beginning to want to hear more. Why did she stop playing?

units.source_text: 还没听出弹得怎么样，真可惜了。”

en.t: I had not yet made out how well she played. What a pity."

units.source_text: 看来此种气氛使他产生了兴趣，接着他又说：“反正是听了，不如让我再靠近一点听，好么？”

en.t: The atmosphere seemed to have stirred his interest, and he went on, "Since I have heard this much already, why not let me listen from a little closer?"

units.source_text: 大辅命妇但愿适可而止，便回答道：“算了吧。

en.t: Dainagon no Myobu hoped to leave matters at that, and answered, "Let it be.

units.source_text: 她这种萧条冷落的光景，走近去听岂不败兴？”

en.t: With her in such a lonely, desolate state, would going closer to listen not spoil the pleasure?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“这话也说得是。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "That is true enough.

units.source_text: 男人和女人初次交往就情投意合，是另一种身份的人做的事。”

en.t: For a man and a woman to meet for the first time and immediately understand each other is something people of another station do."

units.source_text: 他对这女子颇有怜惜之意。

en.t: He felt considerable pity for the woman.

units.source_text: 便答道：“那么，你以后乘便先把我这点心愿告诉她。”

en.t: So he replied, "Then, when you have a suitable chance later, please first tell her of this small wish of mine."

units.source_text: 他似乎另有密约，蹑手蹑脚地准备回去。

en.t: He seemed to have another secret appointment and prepared to slip away on tiptoe.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇便嘲笑他：“万岁爷常常说你这个人太一本正经，替你担心。

en.t: Dainagon no Myobu teased him, "His Majesty often says that you are far too serious, and worries about you.

units.source_text: 我每次听到这话，总觉得好笑。

en.t: Whenever I hear him say that, I always find it amusing.

units.source_text: 你这种偷偷摸摸的样子，教万岁爷看见了，不知道他老人家怎么说呢。”

en.t: If His Majesty were to see you sneaking about like this, I wonder what he would say."

units.source_text: 源氏公子回转身来，笑道：“你又不是外人，不要这样挖苦我吧！

en.t: Prince Genji turned back and said with a smile, "You are no stranger to me, so do not mock me like that.

units.source_text: 你嫌我这种模样轻佻难看，你们女人家的轻佻模样才难看呢！”

en.t: You say I look frivolous and unbecoming like this, but it is the frivolous ways of you women that are truly unbecoming."

units.source_text: 源氏公子一向认为这大辅命妇是个风骚女子，时常对她说这一类话，大辅命妇听了很难为情，默不作声了。

en.t: Prince Genji had always regarded Dainagon no Myobu as a flirtatious woman and often said such things to her, so Myobu was embarrassed and fell silent.
